name: qwen35_rotation_averaged_temporal_pivot

policy.disagreement_decision: Score only proposed candidate answers on the temporal-pivot frames under four cyclic option rotations, average probabilities by answer text, and select the highest mean probability.

known_limitations: The cached temporal-pivot evidence was selected with a SigLIP2 text encoder limited to 64 positions.
The original question-and-options retrieval query can truncate later answer options; Qwen answer generation still receives all options.
